entities.summary: Nam Duck-woo was a performers & entertainers in South Korea (1924-04-22 – 2013-05-18) who made significant contributions during the Modern era. Their work intersected with economic development and trade and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Influenced economic patterns and commercial practices.
